Using IPV6 for online play, you can play with others without opening Bloret Launcher.
IPV6 is a free service provided by your operator, no additional charges. Users who already have it can click the button above to use it directly.
IPV6 online play may not be stable, if you pursue stability, it is recommended to use the Online Client below for online play.

Labels.label_4:
This may take some time, please be patient
Once loading is complete, we will immediately display the options
We load through BMCLAPI used by most launchers
Therefore, the loading speed depends on BMCLAPI loading speed and your network
If it takes a long time to load or is unresponsive, please check the network. If the network is good, it may be a BMCLAPI issue
